body:
Flagged by AI reviewer in PR #1972.

## Problem

`nomad/jobs/healer.hcl` says a missing Telegram secret makes `notify_owner` log `notify: not configured`. The sender specified by #1949 and added in PR #1972 is `bin/notify-owner.sh`, and it logs `notify-owner: not configured` (exit 0). The comment still uses the pre-rewrite function name `notify_owner`.

An operator, or the #1955 implementer, grepping for the string in the jobspec will miss the real line and can treat a correctly unconfigured channel as a broken sender.

This comment predates PR #1972. #1949's affected-file list does not include `healer.hcl`, so the mismatch was not fixed there.

---
*Auto-created from AI review*


## Affected files

- `nomad/jobs/healer.hcl` — the top-of-file comment block that still names the removed function `notify_owner` (line ~15).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `nomad/jobs/healer.hcl` no longer references the pre-rewrite function name `notify_owner`.
- [ ] The comment accurately states that `bin/notify-owner.sh` logs `notify-owner: not configured` when the Telegram secret is missing.
- [ ] No other jobspec or doc in the repo still references the removed `notify_owner` name.
